subject: planner: fix the case that projection prunes all columns (#54650)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: `LogicalProjection.PruneColumns` now drops itself when all output columns are pruned (returns child), and `LogicalSchemaProducer.InlineProjection` now keeps a single “smallest” column when parent uses none, avoiding empty-schema propagation and reducing unused column carry. Searched for correctness/semantics/runtime hazards; the main edge (projection over `LogicalTableDual` producing a 0-column child) is addressed later in upstream by `60c7e61735` (#54778), leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues on master.
